title: Waveshare ESP32 product repository configuration
description: The only product-specific input of the shared CI. Stored as .github/product.json in every product repository.

product.description: Product model. Used as the firmware archive name prefix and in release manifests.

tier.description: Repository level defined in docs/spec.md: 0 hygiene, 1 build, 2 release.

target.description: ESP-IDF target passed to `idf.py set-target` and to esptool.

esp_idf.description: Present when the repository has examples/esp-idf/.

versions.description: ESP-IDF release tags. Every first-party project is built with each of them.

arduino.description: Present when the repository has examples/arduino/.

fqbn.description: Full arduino-cli FQBN including board options.

factory_firmware.description: Present when the factory firmware source is open and lives in firmware/sourcecode/. CI builds it with this one ESP-IDF version. Omit it when the source is closed.

esp_idf.description: ESP-IDF release tag used to build firmware/sourcecode/.

overrides.description: Per-product additions to the template defaults. Lists are appended to the default list; every other value replaces the default.
